block.slack.model.title: Slack
block.slack.model.description: Post, update and read Slack messages with a bot token.
block.slack.security_hint: The bot token stays in the wallet. Only allowlisted conversations can be written to or read.
block.slack.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.slack.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.slack.help_enabled: Off by default. While off, nothing is sent to or read from Slack.
block.slack.help_secret_ref: Wallet reference holding the Slack bot token (xoxb-...), never the token itself.
block.slack.help_allowed_channels: JSON array of channel, private channel or DM IDs, e.g. ["C0123456789", "D0123456789"]. Any other conversation is refused before the wallet is read.
block.slack.help_default_channel: Conversation used when an input gives no channel. It must also be allowed. Leave empty to require channel.
block.slack.help_file_root: Only regular files inside this directory can be uploaded from the file input. Empty disables uploads.
block.slack.help_max_messages: Upper bound and default for one read_history or read_replies operation.
block.slack.help_timeout_sec: Total time for one operation, including pages, upload steps and retries after HTTP 429. Ambiguous writes are never retried.
block.slack.help_page_size: limit sent to conversations.history and conversations.replies; Slack recommends 200 or fewer.
block.slack.help_max_pages: A read stops after this many pages and returns next_cursor to continue later.
block.slack.help_max_retries: Only rate-limited calls, which Slack did not process, are retried.
block.slack.help_max_retry_wait_sec: A Retry-After above this value returns a rate_limited error instead of waiting.
block.slack.help_max_file_bytes: Upper bound for one uploaded file, from 1 KiB to 100 MiB.
block.slack.help_max_response_bytes: Larger Slack responses are refused as protocol errors.
block.slack.help_api_base_url: Keep https://slack.com. Only a loopback test double (http://127.0.0.1:port) may replace it.
block.slack.help_ca_file: Optional absolute PEM file, used only with an HTTPS loopback test double. TLS verification cannot be disabled.
